items.html:
Warehouse does not validate repository_id for GitHub Trusted Publishers. Verified against live main commit 8f38ce5c45aef4f0370509d6651551073a2a82fa (2026-10-02).

  • repository_id is explicitly in __unchecked_claims__; required checks include repository slug, owner name, owner numeric ID, workflow reference, JTI and event. Environment is checked when configured. github.py, lines 146–189
  • Publisher lookup filters repository name, owner name, owner ID and workflow filename, then selects by environment. github.py, lines 195–239
  • The base class defines unchecked claims as claims that are not checked; verification executes only the required and optional verification maps. definition, verification
  • The service invokes publisher lookup and then verify_claims; it also enforces the canonical issuer. services.py, lines 289–319

Inference: Deleting/recreating the exact same owner/repository name under the same numeric owner ID does not itself invalidate the existing publisher: the new repository’s numeric ID is ignored. Matching workflow and configured environment, plus all ordinary token checks, remain necessary.

Limit: current source proof, not confirmation of deployed PyPI revision or a live publishing test. No files, settings or credentials changed.
